scenarios.name: clean_initial_incident
scenarios.reason: Complete source coverage still permits the recalled lot in four shipments while two source-qualified shipments remain excluded.

scenarios.name: known_mapping_reduces_scope
scenarios.reason: A reviewed manifest that fully assigns S-200 to the non-recalled FARM-A lot removes recalled exposure from that shipment only.

scenarios.name: mixed_container_single_scan
scenarios.reason: One retained-case observation accounts for that case but cannot establish the identity of the other cases drawn from an unverified mixed container.

scenarios.name: contradictory_label_and_pick_log
scenarios.reason: A verified C-100 recalled-lot label and an incompatible C-200 pick log leave no feasible history, so every shipment becomes unresolved.

scenarios.name: missing_source_stream
scenarios.reason: An absent required dispatch-source declaration makes the candidate universe incomplete and blocks every exclusion.

scenarios.name: duplicate_inventory_snapshot
scenarios.reason: A repeated shipment identifier is a blocking data-quality issue and must not double inventory or support narrowing.

scenarios.name: same_code_different_sources
scenarios.reason: FARM-B:REC-2026-01 is distinct from the recalled FARM-A:REC-2026-01 despite sharing the lot-code suffix.

scenarios.name: solver_timeout_or_error
scenarios.reason: A timeout or error means computation is incomplete, so supplied scenarios cannot be used to narrow scope.

scenarios.name: rejected_or_unavailable_evidence
scenarios.reason: Rejected evidence does not change the incident, and an unavailable outcome keeps an action's guaranteed resolved quantity at zero.

scenarios.name: evidence_retraction
scenarios.reason: Retracting an accepted manifest rebuilds the incident from active evidence and invalidates the resulting exclusion.
